infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GIH uses the camera to overlay live stars, planets, satellites, and black holes on the sky.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GIH uses your location to calculate where celestial objects appear from where you are standing.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: GIH uses motion sensors so overlays stay aligned with the real sky as you move the phone.
